datasets.name: Precipitation data (TRMM, TAMSAT, and local meteorology services)
datasets.source: Tropical Rainfall Measuring Mission (TRMM), Tropical Applications of Meteorology using Satellite data (TAMSAT), and local agro-meteorology offices
datasets.verbatim: Another entry concerns the precipitation data. These data were combined from three main sources. The Tropical Rainfall Measuring Mission (TRMM) (Braun, 2011), Tropical Applications of Meteorology using Satellite data (TAMSAT) (Maidment et al., 2014) and some local meteorology services.

methods.name: Derivative SLIP/DRIP procedure
methods.summary: An adaptation of the NASA SLIP/DRIP algorithms for data-scarce regions. It uses inverse NDVI, MNMDI, and slope inclination for landslide mapping (SLIP), and logistic regression on rainfall frequency and duration data for triggering threshold identification (DRIP), complemented by a Cox proportional hazards model for site survival analysis.
methods.verbatim: Therefore, this paper proposes a derivative SLIP/DRIP procedure, adapted to countries and world’s areas facing the same difficulties above-listed. ... The licenses of Erdas Imagine 2020 version 16.6.0.1366, ArcGisPro version 2.5 and XLStats 2020.1.64570 software used in this research are properties of StatsN’Maps and available upon request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code is not available, as the authors state it is available only upon request.
